ev_0004.summary: Quadrilateral-with-diagonals figure. Printed letters A (top-left), C (top-right), B (bottom-left), D (bottom, interior-bottom edge). Six straight solid segments: AC (top), AB (left vertical), BD (bottom), DC (right slanted), AD (diagonal A to D), BC (diagonal B to C). The diagonals AD and BC cross at an unlabeled junction point_02 (~246.4,222.4), verified on both seg_01 and seg_03. All strokes solid, no dashed strokes, no curves or circles. No right-angle square marks are drawn, so angle_marks and feet are empty (AB/BD meet at B visually near 90 deg but no square is printed).

Note: the standalone file will not compile on its own without the program-inserted coordinate definitions for A, B, C, D.
